verdicts.reason: A has unwanted collisions: the GROVE wordmark sits on the circle, the headline and body copy run over the circle's right edge, and the shoe is shrunk and pushed off the circle's centre. Its badges and CTA form a ragged zig-zag on the right. B has no collisions and a strong headline, and the product sits cleanly in its circle, but the reading order is jumbled: the CTA is at the top of a stacked pill column with the tilted Free Delivery badge wedged in the middle, and the body copy is pushed to the bottom-right corner as tiny text below the badges.
